summary: NSTS Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by Brookfield Bancshares, Inc. Under terms, each NSTS share will be converted into cash consideration totaling $73.662 million, or approximately $14.28 per share. The board of NSTS recommends approval. The transaction involves a two-step merger structure: NSTS first merges into a Brookfield subsidiary, then into Parent, with the bank subsidiary continuing its charter. The deal is subject to stockholder vote, regulatory approvals, and customary conditions. Watch for stockholder vote timing and regulatory review under the BHC Act and HOLA for risk-arb spread analysis.
